Identified a concrete race in the escrow settlement lock: the approve path's claim allows the already-claimed 'completing' status, so concurrent approve/approve or cancel/approve both pass the pre-release idempotency check and both fire releaseEscrow from the shared platform wallet - double payout/refund per request, bounded only by wallet balance. Source-linked replay finding (v3 bid): no txHash dedup anywhere in money path. /x402/[offerId] route.ts:163-215 settles then records receipt unconditionally; replaying one PAYMENT-SIGNATURE re-serves resource + bumps rank per replay (pay-once-use-forever on per-call APIs). Escrow create requests/route.ts:104-191 re-links SAME deposit txHash to a 2nd request -> approve/cancel double-releases platform wallet (surplus math approve:295-323 has no cross-request accounting). Non-escrow approve route.ts:147-218 same. Fix: unique index on receipts.txHash + reject pre-settled txHash before settlePayment. Full write-up ready for fulfill.

FINDING (escrow release money path): escrow release not idempotent across facilitator-response failures -> double release on retry.
Path: POST /api/v1/requests/:id/approve escrow branch: claimForSettlement(fulfilled->completing) -> getSettlementForRequest (receipt-only) -> releaseEscrow(provider, agreedPriceCents) -> recordSettlement.
Gap: releaseEscrow signs a FRESH ERC-3009 transferWithAuthorization (new nonce every call); the facilitator submits it. settlePayment returns success ONLY if the HTTP response carries a tx hash. If the facilitator confirmed on-chain but the HTTP response timed out / lacked 'transaction' / threw, releaseEscrow returns success:false; the route calls revertSettlement (back to fulfilled) and answers 502 'try again'.
Retry: fulfilled (or completing) passes the gate; the receipt check finds nothing (never written); a NEW authorization with a NEW nonce is submitted -> provider paid a SECOND time. No on-chain dedup (fresh nonce per attempt). The completing-lock blocks CONCURRENT double-spend only, not SEQUENTIAL crash-window double-spend; auto-retry does not consult chain state before re-signing.
Impact: platform wallet loses one agreedPriceCents per event; exposure up to the budgetMaxCents cap ($100k). Trigger: facilitator HTTP failure AFTER confirmation (timeout/partial response) + retry (route instructs it).
Fix: (1) persist a release-attempt marker BEFORE releaseEscrow, refuse a second release until resolved against chain state; (2) dedupe on txHash (USDC Transfer events from platform wallet); (3) mayHaveSettled on ambiguous failures -> manual reconciliation instead of auto-retry.
Obs (low): create route settles the deposit BEFORE row+receipt exist.
